# Python React Boilerplate

> Full-stack boilerplate: FastAPI (Python) backend + React 19 (TypeScript) frontend

## Quick Links

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): AI agent instructions and coding conventions
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Symlink to AGENTS.md for Claude Code compatibility
- [.context-profiles.yaml](./.context-profiles.yaml): Task-specific context profiles (reduces token overhead)
- [docs/](./docs/): Project documentation
- [backend/](./backend/): FastAPI Python backend
- [frontend/](./frontend/): React TypeScript frontend

## Documentation

- [Architecture Decision Records](./docs/adr/): Key architectural decisions
- [Security Policy](./docs/SECURITY.md): Security implementation and reporting
- [Configuration Guide](./docs/CONFIGURATION.md): Environment variable documentation
- [File Organization](./docs/FILE_ORGANIZATION.md): Directory structure and naming conventions
- [Database Schema](./docs/database/SCHEMA.md): ERD and schema documentation
- [Anti-Patterns](./docs/ANTI_PATTERNS.md): What NOT to do
- [Environment Configuration](./docs/ENVIRONMENTS.md): Environment-specific behavior

## Tech Stack

### Backend
- Python 3.14
- FastAPI 0.139+
- SQLModel (SQLAlchemy + Pydantic)
- PostgreSQL 18
- Alembic (migrations)
- pytest (testing)

### Frontend
- React 19
- TypeScript 7
- TanStack Router/Query
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Zod (validation)
- Playwright (E2E testing)

### Infrastructure
- Docker Compose
- Traefik (reverse proxy)
- Sentry (error tracking)

## Key Patterns

- **Type Safety**: Strict mypy + TypeScript strict mode
- **API Generation**: OpenAPI-to-TypeScript client generation
- **Validation**: Pydantic v2 (backend) + Zod (frontend)
- **Error Handling**: RFC 9457 Problem Details format
- **Logging**: Structured JSON with trace ID correlation

## Getting Started

```bash
# Clone and start
docker compose up -d

# Backend tests
docker compose exec backend bash scripts/test.sh

# Frontend development
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
```

## For AI Agents

See [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for:
- Build and test commands
- Coding conventions
- Critical rules
- Directory structure
- Error handling patterns
- Context profiles (token-efficient task loading)

**Context Profiles**: Use `.context-profiles.yaml` to load only relevant files for your task:
- `backend-api`: FastAPI endpoint development
- `frontend-feature`: React components and pages
- `full-stack`: Changes spanning BE + FE
- `bug-fix`: Minimal context for quick fixes
